scene.joint: world-to-body revolute about world Y; body origin and both joint anchors initially at origin
scene.collision: none, no shape or contact detector; this isolates joint drive and reset

common_solver.integrator: default Euler; resolved full config saved

common_run.control_schedule: steps 0..39 positive, steps 40..79 negative; request explicit effort +/-10 N m or PD target +/-1 rad
common_run.sample: initial state plus every output state; save body_q, body_qd, joint_q, joint_qd, joint_lambdas_tau, body_qdd, control arrays, status fields, internal applied body wrench and time
common_run.performance: timing metadata only, no performance ranking

cases.title: 显式力矩与有界隐式PD：相同力限下的正反饱和响应
cases.independent_reference: For rotor inertia I=1+1*(0.5)^2=1.25, signed applied effort is +/-1. Compute velocity from cumulative tau*dt/I and Euler position from cumulative updated velocity. Also report continuous-time position (expected dt discretization gap); do not require equal performance.
cases.threshold_rationale: At peak expected velocity 0.16 rad/s, 0.002 is 1.25%; 0.001 rad is well below the 0.032 rad pulse displacement. Effort error 0.002 is 0.2% of the imposed physical bound. Anchor drift 0.5 mm is 0.1% of COM radius. Limits permit float32 iterative integration but reject missing clamping, wrong branch/sign and order-of-magnitude inertia errors.
limitations: Saturated branch only; does not calibrate unsaturated PD tracking, effort limit transitions or multi-DoF joints
PADMM CPU, single revolute, no gravity/contact/armature
Internal arrays are instrumentation, not a supported application API

cases.title: 有历史求解器默认reset与全新求解器的同初态重放

variants.A: fresh solver + default reset + pulse replay

cases.warmup: 60 steps at dt=.005: 40 positive-target, 20 negative-target; save history arrays before reset
cases.control_ownership: Capture control before/after reset and require byte-identical values; explicitly set replay control afterwards. Reset receives State only and is not claimed to clear external Control.
cases.threshold_rationale: Default reset writes model initial float32 data and zeros; near-machine exact reset threshold checks lifecycle, while replay uses established independent-process tolerances. Nonzero warmup gates ensure reset was not vacuous.
limitations: Tests default ResetConfig but explicitly uses internal warmstarting, not all warmstart modes
Status is recorded but exact iteration-count equality is not a physical criterion

cases.title: preserve reset保持运动状态并清除历史后的重放

variants.A: warm donor creates consistent body state; new solver receives only copied body_q/body_qd then preserve reset
variants.B: same 60-step warmup; aged solver preserve reset

cases.threshold_rationale: Preserve means pose/velocity should remain within float32 conversion roundoff. Fresh comparison receives no historical multipliers; replay equality tests observable reset isolation without relying on private scratch-buffer layouts.
limitations: Preserve assumes supplied body states are consistent; no projection of invalid states is claimed
Single world, no contact-history matching or masked reset
The fresh reference also uses preserve reset to derive consistent joint data from body state

failure_policy: Keep every failed run and its protocol/runner/log. No threshold widening after observation. Implementation-only runner fixes require parent review and explicit new runner fingerprint; any scenario/criteria revision gets a new version before another measured run.
reviewed_by: root agent: static source and physical reference review before any runtime
